Submitted. The repaired proposal now sits cleanly at the fallback level:

- **Op 1 (§ 14.2.2, p0755):** PB as Customer may terminate for convenience at any time on **90 days'** prior written notice (fallback band, dropping the preferred-only 30-day figure and the "in whole or in part" extra), with the exit payment cut from 300% of Development Costs to **an amount not exceeding three (3) months' Development Costs as the sole early-termination fee**. The Approval Payment sentence is untouched byte-for-byte.
- **Op 2 (new § 14.2.11, after p0781):** SFJ as Vendor may terminate for convenience **only effective at the end of the then-current term** and **only upon 90 days' prior written notice**, expressly limiting §§ 14.2.6 and 14.2.10.

All official checks, the precision positions, and the minimality gate return ok:true; status remains **deviation**.
